model: Each report estimates the SAME unknown fixed voltage theta: y_i=theta+loading_i*z+epsilon_i. z and all epsilon_i have zero mean, are mutually independent, and have the stated known variances. Report values are one realized panel. There are no unknown variance components to estimate.
pooling_policy: Among ALL linear unbiased estimates sum_i w_i*y_i with sum_i w_i=1, minimize the true variance. Signed weights are allowed: they are coefficients of estimators, not physical mixture fractions. Preserve source report order for the returned weights.
comparison_policy: The proposed independence report uses inverse-MARGINAL-variance weights (including each shared-offset contribution on its diagonal) but ignores every off-diagonal covariance. Its reported variance is the reciprocal of the sum of these marginal precisions. Separately compute the ACTUAL variance of that SAME naive-weight estimator under the true joint model. Do not compare the naive reported variance with the optimal estimator variance as if they described one estimator.

provenance.data_origin: Explicitly constructed numerical instrument/reporting studies for this benchmark; not measurements from a named laboratory or archive.
provenance.method_scope: Conditional finite-dimensional linear measurement models. Scientific conclusions follow from the stated covariance/distance definitions; no distributional or causal interpretation beyond those assumptions.
